title: ETA / Unitas 6497-2 — Exploded Watch Anatomy
summary: A movement-first 3D explainer of a large hand-wound mechanical watch, now with causal winding, two stem positions, animated keyless selection, hand-setting interaction, stored mainspring energy, provenance-aware inspection, and constrained train geometry.

facts.Current pass: M4b stem position selects winding vs setting; sliding pinion/yoke shift and setting input moves hour/minute hands
